Once unpaused, liquidations could proceed, and rsETH could be sold — but at what price? The oracle price for rsETH — if it's an exchange rate or market price... rsETH/ETH oracle. If rsETH is still ~1 ETH, then the position is actually fully collateralized (52,999 rsETH ≈ 52,999 ETH vs 52,439 WETH debt) and there's no bad debt at all! The collateral is worth slightly MORE than the debt.

Hmm interesting. So the "bad debt" claim in O06 (BWEnews) may be premature/wrong. The attacker supplied 52,999 rsETH and borrowed 52,439.6 WETH — collateral ratio ~101%. If rsETH holds its peg to ETH (it's backed by staked ETH), Aave can liquidate once token transfers resume and recover the debt. But also: Aave changed e-mode categories and removed borrowing power — that was to prevent further borrowing against rsETH. Also DAO may take further actions (e.g., freeze WETH? unlikely).

This is a liquidity crisis for suppliers. The user's $1,000 WETH cannot be withdrawn right now anyway (idle = 13 WETH).
